channel.title: The AI Sales Leader: Insights
channel.description: Straight answers on sales leadership, revenue growth, and AI-powered sales teams, from Greg Grand.

item.title: How to Hold Salespeople Accountable Without Micromanaging
item.description: Learn how to hold salespeople accountable for performance and process adherence without micromanaging. Implement clear systems and use AI to drive real results.

item.title: How to Fix an Inaccurate Sales Forecast (Stop Forecasting Hope)
item.description: Stop forecasting hope. Learn how to fix an inaccurate sales forecast by implementing Greg Grand's Three-Bucket Forecast system, focusing on objective process and real deal criteria to drive predictable revenue. Get specific steps to improve your sales predictability.

item.title: Why Is My Sales Team Not Hitting Quota? The 5 Real Reasons
item.description: Discover why your sales team isn't hitting quota. Greg Grand cuts through the noise to expose the 5 real reasons and offers concrete fixes for CEOs and founders.

item.title: How Sales Managers Should Coach With AI Call Recordings
item.description: Learn how sales managers should coach with AI call recordings. Greg Grand shows founders how to build systems for effective, consistent sales coaching.

item.title: How to Grow Revenue from Existing Accounts You've Already Won
item.description: Stop leaving money on the table. Learn how to grow revenue from existing accounts with proactive systems, skilled teams, and AI insights. Get Greg Grand's direct strategies.

item.title: Why AI Sales Tools Fail Without a Sales Process Underneath
item.description: AI sales tools promise much but often fail without a clear, repeatable sales process. Discover why your sales tech isn't delivering and how to fix it.

item.title: AI Roleplay for Objection Handling: Practice Before It Costs You a Deal
item.description: Master sales objection handling with AI roleplay. Learn Greg Grand's direct method for turning prospect objections into opportunities, building rep confidence, and closing more deals before they're lost.

item.title: AI Sales Forecasting for Small Business: Math In, Hope Out
item.description: Learn how to use AI for sales forecasting in a small business by building a solid process first. Replace optimistic fiction with reality based on clear data.

item.title: How to Measure ROI of AI Tools on a Sales Team
item.description: Learn Greg Grand's direct method for how to measure ROI of AI tools in sales. Stop guessing and start tracking real impact on your sales team's results.

item.title: Fractional CRO vs. VP of Sales: Which Hire First?
item.description: Deciphering the fractional CRO vs. VP of Sales dilemma. Learn which sales leader to hire first to build and scale your revenue engine for predictable growth.

item.title: What Is a Fractional CRO, and When Do You Need One?
item.description: Understand what a fractional CRO does and when your company needs one. Learn how to diagnose sales issues and build strong revenue systems, not just temporary fixes.

item.title: Can AI Write Cold Emails That Don't Sound Like AI? Yes: Here's How
item.description: Discover how to make AI write cold emails that don't sound like AI. Implement proven systems to craft personalized, high-converting outreach, boosting your sales pipeline.

item.title: AI Workshop for Revenue Growth: Architecting Account Expansion
item.description: Learn how an AI workshop for revenue and account growth helps founders and sales leaders build systems, not chaos. Architect real expansion, not just hopeful pipeline. Greg Grand's direct guidance.

item.title: How to Scale Sales with AI Without Losing the Human Touch
item.description: Learn how to truly scale sales with AI. Greg Grand reveals the process-first approach to integrating AI that preserves human connection and drives real revenue.

item.title: AI Sales Strategy Roadmap Template: A CRO's Blueprint
item.description: Build an AI sales strategy roadmap template. Greg Grand offers a CRO's practical blueprint for integrating AI into sales process and coaching.

item.title: Salesforce AI Training Alternatives for Live Instruction
item.description: Beyond generic software tutorials, discover effective Salesforce AI training alternatives that offer live instruction focused on your specific sales process.

item.title: Executive Sales Mastermind Group for AI Leaders: The Forum
item.description: Join an executive sales mastermind group for AI. Gain frameworks, peer insights, and direct strategies to lead your sales team through the AI revolution. Stop guessing, start leading.

item.title: How to Modernize a Sales Team with AI: A CRO's Guide
item.description: A battle-tested CRO's guide on how to modernize a sales team with AI. Focus on process first, not tools, to genuinely transform your revenue engine.

item.title: CASL: The Definitive AI Sales Leadership Certification
item.description: Learn why an AI sales leadership certification like CASL is critical for today's sales leaders. Build real systems, not just tools. Master process, people, and pipeline with AI for growth that expands.

item.title: How to Roll Out AI to a Sales Team: System First, Tools Second
item.description: Learn how to roll out AI to a sales team successfully. Greg Grand explains why process standardization must precede AI tools for real revenue gains.
